record.bible_text: And it came to pass after<WH0310> this, that Absalom<WH053> the son<WH01121> of David<WH01732> had a fair<WH03303> sister<WH0269>, whose name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Tamar<WH08559>; and Amnon<WH0550> the son<WH01121> of David<WH01732> loved<WH0157><WTH8799> her.
